note: The models of World in the game (plan 0023, R1). Each entry: "id" is the name in the game, "order" is the order of World (World docs/factory.md), "levels" are the levels that the game uses, "impostor" is true for a model in rows and crowds (D5, R8), "uses" are the plans and the places, and "catalog" is the ID of the catalog of plan 0023, section 9. tools/world/fetch.py gets the files to assets/world/, and data/world/lock.json pins them.
